Missing for 10: an explicit documented create-index → add-records → query walkthrough for agents, evidence that the MCP server can write or index (it is described only for search, analytics, and recommendations), headless CLI auth (sign-in opens a browser), and a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404).

Agent Studio connects an LLM to Algolia and grounds responses in live index data. It can be used to build content summarizers, conversational search and shopping assistants that recommend items. Recommend adds ML-based suggestions such as frequently-bought-together and trending items. However, these are tools for building end-user experiences, and the search analytics only provide conventional metrics (popular searches, no-results, CTR), not AI-generated insights for the account owner inside the dashboard. The MCP server exposes analytics to external agents rather than in-product. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced in the Algolia dashboard from the user's own analytics and data, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Studio's insight quality.
